description: This file is a shell script aimed at testing and manipulating Git's packed-refs file. It includes test functions to verify whether the packed-refs file is correctly marked, updated, and preserved during various Git operations. It primarily performs tests related to Git ref management, especially regarding the marking and handling of the packed-refs file and references.

methods.name: mark_packed_refs
methods.description: Adds an identifying mark to the header line of the .git/packed-refs file to signal that it has been processed by the script or specific tests.

methods.name: check_packed_refs_marked
methods.description: Checks whether the .git/packed-refs file contains the marking added by mark_packed_refs, indicating it has been processed or marked.
